items.excerpt: OpenAI's first hardware product, designed with Jony Ive's LoveFrom, is reportedly a screenless, rechargeable smart speaker with a camera and sensors built to behave like a 'humanlike' AI companion running an advanced ChatGPT model.

New reporting details OpenAI's debut device as a portable, screenless speaker with a camera and other sensors, positioned as a proactive AI companion and the first consumer product from the Ive-led io team.

Adobe adds a generative 'AI Playground' to its experimental Project Indigo camera app, letting mobile shooters remove distractions, apply artistic styles and get real-time photo guidance at the point of capture.

Samsung launches a beta 'Health Assistant,' an AI chatbot inside Samsung Health that interprets data from Galaxy phones, watches and rings and offers physician-validated wellness guidance across its device ecosystem.

Samsung's System LSI division is developing a dedicated 'Gaia' AI accelerator for PCs, a companion NPU to offload on-device generative AI, real-time translation and image generation, with HP and Lenovo reportedly validating prototypes.
